<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>4D Group – Engineering Services Ltd. | Jerusalem</title>
<meta name="description" content="4D Group Engineering Services Ltd. – waterproofing, thermal insulation, shotcrete works and engineering services in Jerusalem.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
  :root{
    --graphite:#1f2226; --graphite-2:#2c3036; --steel:#9d9d9b; --silver:#d9dadb;
    --gold:#ffcc03; --gold-deep:#e19f0a; --ink:#1f2226; --muted:#62676d;
    --line:#e6e7e9; --bg:#f5f5f4; --white:#fff;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{font-family:"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--white);line-height:1.6}
  a{color:inherit}
  .wrap{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

  /* Header */
  header{position:sticky;top:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);z-index:10;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:76px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none}
  .brand img{height:52px;width:auto}
  .brand-text{line-height:1.15}
  .brand-text b{display:block;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .brand-text small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
  nav a{margin-left:28px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 40%,#fff8dc 0%,rgba(255,248,220,0) 45%),linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%,#f3f3f2 100%);padding:90px 0 96px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:28px;height:3px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:2px}
  .hero h1{font-size:48px;line-height:1.12;margin:18px 0 20px;color:var(--graphite)}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 62%,rgba(255,204,3,.55) 62%)}
  .hero p{font-size:19px;color:var(--muted);max-width:600px}
  .actions{margin-top:34px;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .btn{display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;transition:.2s}
  .btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--graphite)}
  .btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold-deep)}
  .btn-ghost{border:2px solid var(--graphite);color:var(--graphite)}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--graphite);color:#fff}
  .hero-logo{display:flex;justify-content:center}
  .hero-logo img{width:100%;max-width:300px;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(31,34,38,.12))}

  /* Strip */
  .strip{background:var(--graphite);color:#fff}
  .strip .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .strip div.item{padding:26px 20px;border-left:1px solid #3a3f46;font-size:15px;color:var(--silver)}
  .strip div.item:first-child{border-left:none}
  .strip b{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:2px}

  /* Sections */
  section{padding:90px 0}
  .alt{background:var(--bg)}
  .sec-head{margin-bottom:46px}
  h2{font-size:34px;color:var(--graphite);margin:10px 0}
  .lead{color:var(--muted);max-width:680px;font-size:17px}

  .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(245px,1fr));gap:22px}
  .card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.25s}
  .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-deep));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:.3s}
  .card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(31,34,38,.08)}
  .card:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
  .ico{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--graphite);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
  .ico svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:var(--gold);fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .card h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--graphite)}
  .card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}

  /* About */
  .about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:54px;align-items:start}
  .about p + p{margin-top:14px}
  .facts{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
  .facts-head{background:var(--graphite);color:#fff;padding:16px 26px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .facts-head::before{content:"";width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold)}
  .facts .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15px}
  .facts .row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .facts .row span:first-child{color:var(--muted)}
  .facts .row span:last-child{font-weight:600;text-align:right}

  /* Team */
  .team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:22px}
  .person{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:30px;display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;border-left:5px solid var(--gold)}
  .avatar{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--graphite-2),var(--graphite));color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .person h3{font-size:20px;color:var(--graphite)}
  .role{color:var(--gold-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}

  /* Contact */
  .contact-box{background:var(--graphite);border-radius:16px;padding:54px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;color:#fff}
  .contact-box h2{color:#fff}
  .contact-box .lead{color:var(--silver)}
  .c-list{display:grid;gap:14px}
  .c-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:var(--graphite-2);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px}
  .c-item .ico{margin:0;background:var(--gold);width:44px;height:44px}
  .c-item .ico svg{stroke:var(--graphite)}
  .c-item small{display:block;color:var(--steel);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
  .c-item a,.c-item span{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:16px}

  footer{background:#16181b;color:var(--steel);padding:30px 0;font-size:14px}
  footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
  footer .f-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
  footer .f-brand img{height:40px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px}

  @media (max-width:860px){
    nav{display:none}
    .hero{padding:60px 0}
    .hero-grid,.about,.contact-box{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .hero-logo{order:-1}
    .hero-logo img{max-width:180px}
    .hero h1{font-size:34px}
    .strip .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
    .strip div.item:nth-child(3){border-left:none}
    .contact-box{padding:34px 24px}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="hero">

      <span class="eyebrow">Engineering Services · Jerusalem</span>

      <p>4D Group Engineering Services Ltd. delivers insulation, shotcrete and engineering services for residential, commercial and infrastructure projects.</p>

</div>

<section id="services">

        <h3>Waterproofing</h3>

      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 11l9-7 9 7"/><path d="M5 10v10h14V10"/><path d="M8 14h8M8 17h8"/></svg></div>

      <div class="card">

      <p style="color:var(--muted)">Our team combines engineering, architecture and surveying expertise with hands-on site experience. We work on residential, commercial and public projects, and partner with general contractors as a specialist subcontractor.</p>
